recap.text: Carl spends several minutes in the first safe room sifting his boxes and finds a potion, a potion, a torch, bandages that stop Bleed effects, and a silver ring from the silver Adventurer Box that raises his Constitution to ten. After the baby-killing achievements and two Asshole Boxes, which put a tattoo on his goddamned neck, the boss box gives him a plus-two ring of constitution. He wears it on his left ring finger, and his score reaches twelve.

Carl finds three dead crawlers lying together, and one of them, a human named Nica, still wears two rings, each plus two to strength. Donut can't wear them, so Carl rubs the blood off and puts them on beside his two constitution rings, which makes four rings in all. His strength comes back to an acceptable level, and he takes no joy in looting fellow crawlers.

beats.headline: Silver box, silver ring
beats.text: In the first safe room, with a cup of cold, pure water at a booth, Carl spends several minutes sifting through his boxes. Potion, potion, torch, and bandages that stop Bleed effects, which are new. All the same stuff, except for a silver ring in the silver Adventurer Box he got for finding his first safe room. It gives him plus one to Constitution, bringing the stat up to ten. In the same sitting Donut's gold box gives her a little silver butterfly charm.
beats.gist: Carl's silver Adventurer Box holds a ring that adds plus one to his Constitution, making it ten.

beats.headline: Another ring of constitution
beats.text: After the baby-killing achievements and the two Asshole Boxes, which put a tattoo on Carl's goddamned neck, the boss box gives him another ring of constitution, this one plus two. He puts it on his left ring finger, and his score comes up to twelve. The gold Looter Box beside it holds a single item, a skill potion.
beats.gist: Carl wears a plus-two ring of constitution from the boss box on his left ring finger.

beats.headline: Four rings at once
beats.text: Three dead crawlers lie together, and one of them, a human named Nica, still wears two rings, each plus two to strength. Donut can't wear them, so Carl rubs the blood off and puts them on himself beside his two constitution rings, which makes four rings in all. Just like that, his strength is back to an acceptable level. He takes no joy in looting fellow crawlers.
beats.gist: Carl rubs the blood off Nica's two strength rings and wears them beside his two constitution rings.
